description: Adopt shared logging for sets, measurements and corrections (#669; REQ-019, C45; R82, R100, R115, R116; TASK-AC-4E98D150903F, TASK-AC-2990AF36316E, TASK-AC-342CDDB7111A; foundation provider for JOURNEY-019). On the real /workout route a standard block movement entry (ExerciseSetLogger with focused, drawn by StandardBlock) - the anchor/primary lift, another lift, a timed movement, a distance movement, an extra set and a saved-set correction - opens in the shared focused LoggingOverlay (src/ui/refinements/logging-overlay.tsx): a native modal over an inert workout, titled with the entry title, collapsed by its framed icon-only Close log X or Escape, with the Balanced backdrop and no half-sheet. The logger keeps its fields, draft, the original set-observation writer (insert, correct, clear), the TASK-020 Save confirmation and the session one rest. check-01 proves it in the browser on a contained synthetic session at 390 (touch; keyboard and reduced motion with a refused write retried under its own id) and 320 (other lift, timed and distance movement), shows a superset round staying on its half-sheet (TASK-044, not delivered here), and opens the accepted gallery states ?state=anchor, other-lift, timed-movement, distance-movement, extra-set and set-correction (reference eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d, the route StandardBlock over an in-memory set-observation client) in all four skins at 390. Every declared case must execute and pass.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-043 --check check-01 -- npx playwright test e2e/refinement/task-043.spec.ts --project=mobile
